meaning:
ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wis.12:10 * ;]
1. innate (Wis.12:10).
2. rooted, implanted: Jas.1:21 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
